Strategy: Combine the widened gentle fifteen sweet band gated behind three open bins with the mid penalty and an exact-fit bonus. This stacks three preferences that each helped alone, but the lower gate may steer in sparse states where Best Fit already chooses well.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [1000.0 if r - item == 0 else (-(r - item) + (15 if len(bins) >= 3 and r - item >= 28 and r - item <= 48 else 0) - (15 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0)) for r in bins]
```
